screener._note: Hard gates: min_return_2d, min_return_5d and min_market_cap. Everything else is an OPTIONAL tightening knob, OFF by default (0 / false = informational only — still computed, displayed and scored). To re-enable as filters: raise min_price / min_rvol / min_avg_dollar_vol above 0 (e.g. 10 / 1.5 / 20e6) or set require_above_ma20/50 to true. The doubler list follows the same min_price / min_avg_dollar_vol knobs.
